hotels.vendor_name: Ardour Milton Park Bowral (formally Milton Park Country House Hotel & Spa)
hotels.title: NSW Southern Highlands Country Estate Luxury with Signature Dining & Renowned Gardens
hotels.description: Discover a boutique retreat in the Southern Highlands just two hours from Sydney. With French Provencal elegance and 44 luxurious rooms overlooking stunning gardens or pine forests, this hotel offers a truly romantic escape. Enjoy high tea on The Terrace, cocktails at The Polo Bar, or fine dining at Hordens Restaurant. Explore the only English School of Landscape garden outside Europe, then unwind in your sumptuous, delicately designed room, all within the serene beauty of this exceptional estate.

hotels.title: Southern Highlands Countryside Escape with Daily Breakfast & Dining Credit
hotels.description: Find adventure and classic comforts tucked away in the New South Wales Southern Highlands at this peaceful property, a charming escape easily accessible from Sydney, Canberra and the South Coast. Exchange city crowds for hundred-year-old trees, unwinding against a backdrop of breathtaking gardens, a sprawling golf course and - the star of the show - a beautiful heritage building bursting with country appeal. This hideaway invites guests to venture inwards, leave the chaos of the city behind and indulge in a truly tranquil trip. Swing and putt on the golf course, enjoy inspired dishes at Hickory's Restaurant and Bar, or settle in by the fire in the guest lounge. There are also plenty of opportunities for excitement, from playing friendly tennis matches to enjoying a nightcap around the billiards table.
